cohort: Adults and children diagnosed with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) or inflammatory rheumatic disease (IRD) in Denmark between 1994 and 2018.
finding: Patients with IRD and IBD treated with biologics had a significantly higher risk of TB disease compared to biologic-naive patients (IRR 3.2), with risk further increased in IGRA-positive individuals and those born in intermediate or high TB incidence countries.
